context.transcript:
Hello.
Thank you for coming in to meet with me.
In your email, you mentioned that you're looking to rent some space in an office building.
Yes, our current office is too small, so my business partner Jane and I would like your help in finding a larger one.
Sure.
Are there any requirements you have for the location?
Hmm.
Jane, what do you think?
I want to make sure we have enough parking.
Most of our employees drive to work.
Right.
And it's also important that the office has short-term lease options.
Our office is still expanding and we don't know if the space will be large enough in the future.
context.transcript_translation:
您好。
感谢您来和我见面。
在您的邮件中，您提到您正在寻找租用办公楼空间。
是的，我们现在的办公室太小了，所以我和我的商业伙伴 Jane 希望您能帮我们找到一个更大的地方。
当然可以。
您对地点有什么要求吗？
嗯。
Jane，你觉得呢？
我想确保我们有足够的停车位。
我们的员工大部分是开车上班的。
对。
而且办公室最好提供短期租赁选项也很重要。
我们的办公室还在扩张中，未来空间是否足够大尚不确定。
